_comment: Personality traits (#176). docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-23-traits-design.md is the design; core/traits.gd reads this file. Every effect is {when, gives, text?}: `when` keys biome/board/night/band/site are decided at fight start (step 1) and bloodied/first_round/alone/vs_faction/vs_type/dtype_in/dtype_out at the roll (step 2); `gives` keys ac/to_hit/save/initiative/damage/ward/save_adv/speed/death_save_adv are live in a fight and hardship_adv/hardship_dis/hardship_bonus/grudge on a hardship's save (step 3), the rest (skill, travel, forage, gold, opinion...) are shown and marked not yet in play. Earned rows (step 3) carry `kind` (triumph/resilience/scar/wound), `lasts_days` for one that lapses, `heals`/`cure` for the page; an id may be instanced as `id@arg` (grudge@goblinoid), and `$arg`/`$name`/`$Name` in the row are that faction. Each live trait's `_measured` line is tests/sweep_traits.gd's (2026-09-23): none moves the win rate by more than 3 points, which is the seed noise floor — re-run it when a number here changes.

brave.text: Walks toward the thing everyone else is backing away from.
brave._measured: MEASURED 2026-09-23 (tests/sweep_traits.gd, 300 seeds, all three presets holding it, normal): win 88.7% vs 88.7% (+0.0) — never fired: no fear save in the sweep's rosters

−2 when the company tries to slip past a band

emboldened.name: Emboldened
emboldened.text: Came through it without a scratch, and has not stopped moving since.

overconfident.name: Overconfident
overconfident.text: Came through it without a scratch, and has decided that is how it goes.

renowned.name: Renowned
renowned.text: The one who killed it. People have started saying the name first.

effects.text: That faction's bands come looking for them

arrogant.name: Arrogant
arrogant.text: The one who killed it, and nobody is allowed to forget.

effects.text: −5 with every hero in the company

delver.name: Delver
delver.text: Has been to the bottom of one, and knows what the walls are telling them.

reckless.name: Reckless
reckless.text: Has been to the bottom of one, and has stopped looking where they step.

effects.text: −1 on saves against traps and hazards

protector.name: Protector
protector.text: Got a friend back up once. Stands over the fallen now without deciding to.

steady-hands.name: Steady hands
steady-hands.text: Got a friend back up once. The hands remember how.

giant-killer.name: Giant-killer
giant-killer.text: Has put down something that should have been out of their reach.

veteran.name: Veteran
veteran.text: Twenty fights won. Knows the shape of the first few seconds.

fire-tempered.name: Fire-tempered
fire-tempered.text: Went down in the fire, and came back up out of it.

burn-shy.name: Burn-shy
burn-shy.text: Went down in the fire. Flinches at the smell of it now.
burn-shy.cure: Win against something that deals fire, then make the save again

frost-hardened.name: Frost-hardened
frost-hardened.text: The cold had them once and let go. It will not get the same grip twice.

chilled.name: Chilled
chilled.text: The cold had them once. They have never quite warmed up.
chilled.cure: Win against something that deals cold, then make the save again

storm-struck.name: Storm-struck
storm-struck.text: Lightning found them and they are still here. They move before the flash now.

storm-shy.name: Storm-shy
storm-shy.text: Lightning found them. Every open sky at night is waiting to do it again.
storm-shy.cure: Win against something that deals lightning, then make the save again

grudge.name: Grudge: $name
grudge.text: $Name put them down twice. They have not forgotten, and they are not frightened — they are angry.

haunted.name: Haunted by $name
haunted.text: $Name put them down twice. They see them in every treeline.
haunted.cure: Win a fight against them, then make the save again

hardened.name: Hardened
hardened.text: Watched a friend die and kept their feet. Something in them set, like mortar.

hard-to-kill.name: Hard to kill
hard-to-kill.text: Two breaths from the end, and came back. Death has had its chance.

wounded.name: Wounded
wounded.text: Went down and nearly stayed down. It is still healing.
wounded.heals: A long rest at an inn, or three days

shaken.name: Shaken
shaken.text: Something happened they cannot put down yet.
shaken.heals: Five days (two for a Calm hero)

maimed.name: Maimed
maimed.text: Two breaths from the end, and it took something with it.
maimed.heals: A long rest in a city, where the healers are; or ten days

bane.name: $One-bane
bane.text: Has killed enough of $name to know how they die.

events._comment: What an event can leave (spec §6). A triumph rolls `chance`% per hero it touched, then picks an outcome by weight, each weight leaned by the hero's temperament. A hardship is a save: `ability`, `fear` (Brave has advantage, Craven disadvantage), and its `resilience` / `scar`; the DC is 10 + half the attacker's CR, +2 per aggravation, capped at 20.

flawless.label: A hard fight, and nobody went down

lair_cleared.label: Cleared a lair to the bottom

revived.label: Got a friend back on their feet

downed_twice.label: Put down by the same kind twice
